requirements.statement: The HardKAS framework shall build and sign Kaspa L1 transactions deterministically using canonical JSON hashing.
requirements.refined_statement: The HardKAS framework shall build and sign Kaspa L1 transactions deterministically using canonical JSON hashing.
requirements.rationale: Defines a core computational action and behavior the system must perform.

requirements.statement: All private keys stored in real account keystores must be encrypted with scrypt and AES-256-GCM.
requirements.refined_statement: All private keys stored in real account keystores shall be encrypted using scrypt (parameters N=16384, r=8, p=1) and AES-256-GCM.

requirements.statement: The in-memory simulator should execute transaction plans quickly without external network calls.
requirements.refined_statement: The in-memory simulator shall execute a standard transaction plan in ≤ 50 ms without making any outbound external network calls.

requirements.statement: Mainnet transaction broadcasting must be strictly blocked by policy at all times.
requirements.refined_statement: The system shall reject and log 100% of attempted mainnet transaction broadcast calls via network isolation and runtime policy enforcement.
